# QR AI
> Transform any URL into AI-generated QR code artwork instantly

QR AI is a web application that uses Stable Diffusion and ControlNet AI models to convert standard QR codes into visually stunning, fully scannable artwork. Users enter a URL, choose an art style, and receive a beautiful functional art QR code in seconds. No design skills required.

## Key Features
- AI-powered QR code art generation using Stable Diffusion + ControlNet
- 13 curated art styles: Ukiyo-e, Expressionism, Dreamy, Low Poly Art, Photography, Vector Art, Doodle Art, Ink, Oil Painting, Chinese Art, Watercolor, Sticker, Color Blend
- Random style option for automatic selection
- Adjustable QR weight slider to balance scannability vs. artistic effect
- Instant download of generated artwork
- Personal gallery to save and manage created images
- Free credits included to get started; additional credits available for purchase
- No design skills required

## Use Cases
- Restaurant and café menu QR codes
- Business cards and marketing materials
- Event posters and invitations
- Social media profile links
- Product packaging and retail displays
- Wedding and event invitations
- Portfolio and creative projects

## Technical Details
- URL: https://www.qr-ai.co/generate
- Type: Web application (browser-based, no install required)
- Pricing: Free tier available; credit-based system for additional generations
- Authentication: Google sign-in or anonymous guest access

## About
QR AI is a side project focused on making QR codes beautiful and on-brand. The AI pipeline uses Stable Diffusion 1.5 with two ControlNet units (brightness and QR code monster) to blend the QR pattern with the chosen art style while maintaining scannability.
